content:
Kai Rivera: Hey everyone 
First day! Im Kai (data infra), joining from ORD. Couple quicks: 1) I completed the MDM flow but my machine isnt showing up in `it-inventory`. 2) Security training link in the checklist says 'access denied' when I click the SSO button. 3) Who do I ask about keyboard swaps (I prefer a TKL)? Fun fact: I once mapped every pizza place in Chicago by slice quality :pizza:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome Kai! :tada: If your device is missing in `it-inventory`, run `it-agent status` and paste the output here. For the security training, sometimes SSO tokens need a fresh browser session; try clearing cookies or use an incognito window. Keyboard swaps handled by Facilities -> Hardware Requests; mark "keyboard: TKL" and choose pickup or ship.
Priya Rao: welcome Kai!! :wave: Im your onboarding buddy. Ill follow up on the inventory side. If you want a mechanical keyboard, we have a small pool (MX Browns and Cleans)  I can bring one to your desk.
Diego Vega: hey Kai, welcome to data infra. Re: `it-agent`, if it shows 'unregistered' ping me and Ill escalate to IT. Also add yourself to `#data-platform` and `#infra-debug` channels. For security training, HR sometimes hits a permission bug for new hires; Ill ping HR now.
HR-Bot: Hi Kai  security training access ticket HR-6217 created. You should receive an email with an alternate link within 15-30 minutes. If not, reply here and HR will manually enroll you.
Lina Gomez: hello kai :smile: welcome onboard. If youre remote, we usually ship TKLs via standard courier; if in-office, Priya will drop one off. Also FYI, lunch with the infra team at 12:30 today if you want to join.
Kai Rivera: thanks yall  ran `it-agent status` and it reports `unregistered`. Diego, please escalate. Ill try the incognito trick for training. Priya, would love to borrow a keyboard to test  TKL MX Browns preferred. See you at lunch 12:30!
Diego Vega: escalated to IT ticket IT-9123 for device registration. ETA ~45m. Also added you to `#data-platform` and pushed a tiny onboarding PR to get you access to the internal tooling: `github.com/redwood/onboarding/pulls/12`.
Priya Rao: keyboard noted  will swing by with one after lunch. Also if you fancy pizza recs, Kai, I have a ranked list :joy:
Onboarding-Bot: IT ticket IT-9123 updated: agent registration in progress. HR-6217: security training alternate link sent. Facilities ticket FAC-5075 created for keyboard pickup. Youll receive updates in this thread.
Kai Rivera: awesome, appreciate the quick help. Excited to be here  and yes, pizza recs please :grin:
